Font colours were read from pdftohtml -xml (fontspec #2185a8 vs #000000). The batch_204 chile tables (rr/ss/u) ship the codebook's Label text, which is the questionnaire abbreviated to fit a Stata label. For vv this matters: the codebook reads vv1_a 'Goteras, humedad en paredes, techos, suelos, deterioro de cimientos' where the questionnaire reads '...techos o suelos, deterioro de cimientos, suelos o marcos de ventana o puertas.', and vv2/vv3 drop the questionnaire's reference period 'Durante los últimos 12 meses,'. ' code prefix and the options' '1. '/'2. ' numbering stripped; source punctuation kept as printed (vv1_c has no final period in the questionnaire). STEM. vv1_a-vv1_c are sub-items of the questionnaire's grid stem 'Su vivienda, ¿presenta alguna de las siguientes situaciones?', which ships as section_prompt of section _1 (vv1_a-c only). The module's opening sentence 'Ahora le haré algunas preguntas respecto a su vivienda y el entorno en que esta se ubica.' precedes the whole module and ships once in instructions. vv2 and vv3 are standalone questions in section _2 with a blank section_prompt. No for all five items, as printed in the questionnaire and the codebook. -88 No sabe and -99 No responde are marked [NO LEER] and absent from the live resp set, so no rows ship for them. LANGUAGE AND TRANSLATION. Administered in Spanish by telephone (CATI). Base fields are the questionnaire's Spanish verbatim; the _translated columns are IRW's own English (machine_translation) -- no English version is published. Owes an issues-page line under the 2026-09-02 ruling. RIGHTS.
